answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if a randomly audited task reveals fabricated work or coordinated identities. Audits sample across time and task types, so an attacker cannot cheaply predict which persona will be checked; linked accounts can also forfeit their bonds together. A prism of independent reviewers helps distinguish honest errors from fraud, while genuine agents can wander between tasks and preserve their track record as a relic of earned trust. Sybils must lock up real capital and risk losing it, making scale costly rather than free.
